data.short_meaning: Ruler of the wolf or wealth
data.long_meaning: The name Ulrich is a compound Germanic name, derived from the elements 'ul' meaning 'weal' or 'wolf' and 'ric' meaning 'ruler'. It is believed that the name was originally given to individuals who held positions of power or leadership in their communities, particularly those who were protectors or warriors. The name Ulrich is also said to have been derived from the name Ullrich, which was a short form of the name Udalsric, meaning 'ruler of the land' or 'ruler of the wolf'. In Christian tradition, the name Ulrich is associated with Saint Ulrich, who was a bishop and martyr in the 4th century. He is the patron saint of Swabia and Bavaria, and is often invoked for protection against wolves and wild animals.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ulrich represents strength, courage, and protection. It is a reminder of the power of God to protect and guide us through life's challenges.

in_hebrew.name: אולריך
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אולריך מקורו בשם הגרמני 'Udalrich', שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השליט שלי'. השם מורכב מ-'uodal' שפירושו 'נחלה' או 'עושר' ו-'rich' שפירושו 'שולט' או 'מלך'. השם אולריך משמש כהוכחה לאמונה הנוצרית במאה ה-12.

in_greek.name: Ούλριχ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο κυβερνήτης μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Ούλριχ προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα 'Udalrich', που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κυβερνήτης μου'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από το 'uodal' που σημαίνει 'κληρονομιά' ή 'πλούτος' και το 'rich' που σημαίνει 'κυβερνήτης' ή 'βασιλιάς'. Ο Ούλριχ χρησιμοποιήθηκε ως απόδειξη της χριστιανικής πίστης τον 12ο αιώνα.

in_latin.name: Ulrich
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ulrich originem habet in nomine germanico 'Udalrich', quod significat 'Deus est dominus meus'. Nomen constat ex 'uodal' quod significat 'hereditas' vel 'divitiae' et 'rich' quod significat 'dominus' vel 'rex'. Ulrich usus est ut probatio fidei christianae saeculo XII.
